question: The cost price of an article is (7)/(6) times the selling price. What is the loss/gain percentage (correct up to two decimal places)?
solution: Given: The cost price of an article is (7)/(6) times the selling price. Concept used: Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%
